text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"You are located approximately 30 meters from a reported car bomb explosion hazard in Thiyagaraya Nagar.","main_move":"MOVE_AWAY","main_move_text":"Evacuate the immediate area and move away from the suspected vehicle to protect against blast and debris.","where_to_go":"Move at least 500 meters away from the vehicle site at latitude 13.041, longitude 80.234.","do_now":[{"text":"Evacuate the building immediately moving away from the side facing the threat.","advice_ids":["ADV_EVACUATE_01"]},{"text":"Stay away from glass windows, exterior doors, and line of sight to the vehicle.","advice_ids":["ADV_GLASS_SAFETY_01"]},{"text":"Cover your head and neck if you hear an explosion or breaking glass.","advice_ids":["ADV_PROTECT_HEAD_01"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not approach, touch, or examine any suspicious vehicles or packages.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONOT_TOUCH_01"]},{"text":"Do not use elevators during an emergency evacuation.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONOT_ELEVATOR_01"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"indoors on the ground floor","text":"Move away from windows to an interior room or evacuate out the rear exit away from the car.","advice_ids":["ADV_INDOOR_POS_01"]}],"call":["112","100"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Location coordinates place you within the direct impact zone of the reported vehicle threat.","unknowns":["Exact explosive yield or nature of the threat","Active police perimeter boundaries"],"valid_while":["Until local authorities and the bomb disposal squad issue an all-clear"]}
